name: Place de la Sirène
description: Classy area with bistros, cafes and boutiques. Well-to-do families drink coffee and eat pastries at outdoor tables, and a mermaid fountain graces the centre of the square.

objective.name: Get out of the open and into cover

name: Grand Magasin Martin
description: Sprawling, multi-level department store selling most anything you can imagine. State-of-the-art escalators ferry fur-coated customers up and down between sections.

objective.name: Find your way out of the maze-like building

name: Graveyard
description: A new, German-only graveyard with memorials for officers who died during the conquest of France. A military funeral is wrapping up as the vampires arrive.

name: Hôtel L'Étoile
description: Very swish hotel that caters to families of visiting dignitaries. One of the last functional grand pianos in Paris takes pride of place in the sixth-storey bar.

name: Catacombs
description: Paris is home to many tunnels, sepulchres, forgotten mausolea — natural places for vampires. Navigating underground is difficult thanks to centuries of disrepair.

objective.name: Get into (and subsequently out of) the subterranean labyrinth

name: Saint-Médard Church
description: Impressive church with well-maintained stained glass windows, oak pews and a grand central altarpiece. Empty when the vampires arrive, but nazi troops soon show up.

objective.name: Punch a hole in the attacking line and get out of there

name: The German Technology Pavilion
description: Exhibition hall showcasing experimental German technology. Experimental fuel sources hum and glow ominously. A deactivated quadrupedal weapons platform stands proudly in the centre.

objective.name: Storm the pavilion and get out the other side

secondary_objectives.name: Power up the weapons platform
secondary_objectives.reward: Access to: Quadrupedal weapons platform (+shrug off incoming fire) and Microwave array turret (+++anti-tank)

name: Metro Station
description: None of the trains are running, but the Metro makes for an excellent means of slipping through the city undetected. Miles of rail tunnels and maintenance shafts.

name: Expensive-Looking Garage
description: Few people owned a car in 1940s Paris. Most vehicles here belong to German expats or diplomats who want to be seen driving something expensive.

objective.name: Steal something flashy and get the hell out of there

name: Le Cochon Noir, French Resistance Hideout
description: A run-down backstreet bar made up entirely of interconnected basements. Smoky, dark, badly-ventilated rooms hold dozens of hard-bitten partisans.

objective.name: Lose the nazis by hiding in the bar

name: Museum of European Warfare
description: Sprawling, poorly-maintained museum with tools of war from a thousand years ago to the modern day. A desperate nazi warlock has animated empty suits of armour and warrior mummies.

objective.name: Smash through the museum before you're overwhelmed by the undead

name: Jardin de Fée, Illuminations and Amusements
description: Nazi-built amusement arcade and illuminations. Europe's third-largest ferris wheel is the crowning glory. Civilians fled without shutting down the machinery.

objective.name: Navigate a collapsing fairground whilst hunted by an entropy witch

name: Exhibition of Degenerate Art
description: Art the nazis deem antithetical to German values, deliberately badly-framed and hung with mocking commentary. Tonight marks one of the largest burnings of art on record.

objective.name: Undertake a very quick and violent gallery tour

secondary_objectives.name: Track down a lost Van Gogh or something
secondary_objectives.reward: No mechanical benefit, but you've got a lost Van Gogh

name: Concert Hall
description: Once festooned with beautiful 17th century decor, now replaced with stark architecture. Dämonenblut is demanding trapped performers finish a Wagner performance, executing audience members for mistakes.

objective.name: Hustle through the corridors and make your way towards Hitler, ignoring the Übermensch

name: Ammunition and Vehicle Depot
description: A collection of cars for use by nazi officers. Most are unremarkable, but root around and you'll find the souped-up bullet-proof black Volkswagen of your dreams.

loot.name: The souped-up bullet-proof black Volkswagen of your dreams

secondary_objectives.name: Raid the ammunition dump
secondary_objectives.reward: Each player restores all uses of any firearms, grenades or similar weapons

name: Nazi Pleasure Gardens
description: The area around the Eiffel Tower remade into pleasure gardens for nazi officers. Winding pathways, thick copses of trees and charming ersatz waterfalls. A garden party is in full swing.

name: The Eiffel Tower
description: Retro-fitted with the latest in German technology. Elevators rocket up the structure, dazzling electric lights blaze out. There's a zeppelin attached to the top containing Adolf Hitler.

name: The Führer's Zeppelin
description: Sumptuous and airborne. Outfitted with marble, silk, gold and mahogany. Grand staircases lead to mezzanine levels loaded with Hitler's own paintings and plundered treasures.

name: Hitler's Broadcast Suite
description: An elaborate set: great banners, an iron and basalt lectern atop a staircase, and a roaring firepit. Hitler awaits with the Werhund — his intention is to broadcast the slaughter live.
